subject: chemistry
content: The current of 1.70 A is passed through 300.0 ml of 0.160 M solution of a ZnSO<sub>4</sub> for 230 sec. with a current efficiency of 90%. Find out the molarity of Zn<sup>2+</sup> after the deposition of Zn. Assume the volume of the solution to remain constant during electrolysis.
